AnyNode Workflow Examples

What is AnyNode? It's anything you want it to be! It's an LLM, or OpenAI, or Gemini, connected node, which does... anything you ask, really! Image manipulation, transforms, writes code, anything you can think of. Really cool stuff!

Check out the Github Repo here:https://github.com/lks-ai/anynode

And join the AnyNodeDiscord
